title: Director of Operations
jd_text:
Director of Operations

Lakeshore Foods runs three production facilities and a cold-chain fleet across the Midwest.

You will own plant scheduling, carrier management, and the warehouse P&L. We want someone who has lived through an ERP migration and kept the trucks moving.

Salary range: $160,000 to $190,000.

fit_notes: Strong: plants, fleet and an ERP migration. Gap: no food-safety certification.

summary: Followed the ATS auto-ack with a short note to the plant HR address from the posting.
next_action: Chase the recruiter if still silent

title: VP Supply Chain (confidential retailer)
jd_text:
Confidential retained search.
Our client is a multi-site specialty retailer with $400M in annual revenue.
The VP Supply Chain owns the distribution center network and all transportation.
You will lead a team of four directors across three distribution centers.
The role reports to the Chief Operating Officer and sits on the leadership team.
Experience with a WMS replacement or network redesign is strongly preferred.
End client disclosed at screen stage.

end client unknown: the guard will keep asking until it is named

fit_notes: Right scope; blind submission risk until the end client is named.

notes: 30 min; ask for the end client name first

fit_notes: A step down in scope, but the brand is strong.

note: six weeks of silence after the auto-ack; recorded, not deleted. Which companies go quiet is pattern knowledge.

skip_reason: Day rate below my floor and 80% travel. Same pattern as every consultancy pitch this year.
